SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  sum(Value) / 30 AS rps
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration'
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  (sum(Sum) / sum(Count)) * 1000 AS avg_latency_ms
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration'
  AND Count > 0
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  avg(Sum / Count) AS avg_size
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.body.size'
  AND Count > 0
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  max(Value) AS goroutines
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND MetricName = 'go.goroutine.count'
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  max(Value) AS memory_used
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND MetricName = 'go.memory.used'
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 30 second) AS time,
  max(Value) AS allocs
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND MetricName = 'go.memory.allocations'
  AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
  AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  Attributes['container'] AS container,
  avg(Value) AS memory
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE ServiceName = 'kubernetes-cadvisor'
  AND MetricName = 'container_memory_working_set_bytes'
  AND Attributes['container'] != ''
  AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
GROUP BY container
ORDER BY memory DESC

SELECT
  Attributes['container'] AS container,
  max(Value) AS cpu_seconds
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE ServiceName = 'kubernetes-cadvisor'
  AND MetricName = 'container_cpu_usage_seconds_total'
  AND Attributes['container'] != ''
  AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
GROUP BY container
ORDER BY cpu_seconds DESC

SELECT
  formatDateTime(Timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS timestamp,
  TraceId AS trace_id,
  SpanName AS operation,
  round(Duration / 1000000, 3) AS duration_ms,
  StatusCode AS status
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime
  AND Timestamp <= $__toTime
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  Timestamp AS timestamp,
  Body AS body,
  SeverityText AS level,
  TraceId AS traceID
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'backend-server'
  AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime
  AND Timestamp <= $__toTime
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200
